# AgenticThat

> AgenticThat runs AI agents for a business's social channels from one workspace: messaging automation, social scraping, scheduled publishing and post engagement.

Website: https://agenticthat.com/
Contact: agenticthat@gmail.com
Address: Vivekananda Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500060, India

## Products

- Chat Workflow Automation: automates contacts, campaigns, templates, inbox replies and outbound messages on WhatsApp and Telegram.
- Social and Search Scrapers: collects public Instagram and Facebook profiles, Pages, posts, reels, comments, views and engagement signals into clean JSON or CSV files. Search results, maps listings and professional profiles are planned.
- Publish Queue Runner: creates, queues, schedules and tracks posts to Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube.
- Post Engagement Agent: runs monitored engagement workflows for posts, replies and interactions across social channels.

## How it runs

- Managed execution for supported work.
- A Local Companion app for account-bound browser sessions, so social account passwords stay on the customer's own machine.
- Human review and visible sessions keep important actions accountable.
